text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugary drinks and fast food. Second, do exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep—most adults need seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health, too. Talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. These simple habits can help you feel happier and healthier.
